ambiguities_or_notes: Exact mounted Russian source bytes match the pinned SHA-256; both volume page markers, all deletion spans, the figure marker, and all three notes are represented.

The manuscript verb кучу in Я кучу с музыкантами is opaque in context and is printed identically in the official volume 2 electronic transcription; it is rendered conservatively as 'I keep company with musicians'. The deleted recurrence я <кучу и> начинаю учиться музыке is rendered consistently as 'I <keep company and> begin to study music'.
волочится за is rendered 'chases after' rather than elevated courtship language, preserving the plan's blunt register.
ездит/выезжает в свет is rendered contextually as 'goes out into society' / 'goes out', not literally as travel.
The source says 'In youth 4 phases' but proceeds through numbered items 1–5, a deleted 6), and a final 6); this inconsistency is preserved exactly rather than corrected.
French Coq du village and coup de grace are retained in the body, with the source's Russian note glosses translated separately as 'Village cock' and 'final blow'.
The source's telegraphic fragments ('Lyubochka—meekness', 'I after a servant girl', 'Volodya—society', etc.) remain fragments rather than being completed into explanatory sentences.
